title: The shape and size of the Earth
地球的形状和大小
blurb: A sphere slightly flattened at the poles: how we know, and how big it is.
地球是两极稍扁的球体：人们是怎么知道的，它有多大。

title: Latitude and longitude
经线和纬线
blurb: Parallels and meridians: the grid that gives every place an address.
纬线和经线：给地球上每个地方一个“地址”。

title: Hemispheres
半球的划分
blurb: North and south, east and west, and why the east–west line is at 20°W and 160°E.
南北半球和东西半球，以及为什么东西半球以 20°W 和 160°E 为界。

title: The Earth's rotation
地球的自转
blurb: West to east, once a day: day and night, and why clocks differ around the world.
自西向东，一天一圈：昼夜交替和时间差异。

title: Revolution and the seasons
地球的公转与四季
blurb: A year around the Sun on a tilted axis: the overhead Sun wanders between the tropics, and the seasons follow.
地轴倾斜着绕太阳公转一年：太阳直射点在南北回归线之间来回移动，四季随之更替。

title: The five heat zones
五带的划分
blurb: The tropics and polar circles cut the Earth into five zones by how much sunshine they get.
回归线和极圈把地球分成五个热量带。

title: Reading maps
地图的阅读
blurb: Scale, direction and legend: the three things you need to read any map.
比例尺、方向和图例：读懂任何地图都离不开这三样。

title: Contour lines and relief maps
等高线地形图
blurb: How a flat map shows hills and valleys: contours, colours and cross-sections.
平面的地图怎样表示高低起伏：等高线、分层设色和地形剖面图。

title: Map projections
地图投影
blurb: Why every flat map stretches something, and why the globe tells the truth.
为什么平面地图总会变形，为什么地球仪最真实。

title: Time zones
时区和日界线
blurb: Why it is noon in Beijing and night in New York, and where each new day begins.
为什么北京正午时纽约是深夜，新的一天又从哪里开始。

title: Where I live
我的家乡
blurb: Your own place on the globe: its coordinates, time, Sun, climate and neighbours.
在地球上找到你的家：经纬度、时间、太阳、气候和周边。

unit: 七年级上册 · 综合题库
title: Grade 7 Term 1 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
七年级上册 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn mock exam covering Earth & graticule, rotation & seasons, contour maps, plates, world climates, and human settlements.
涵盖经纬网、地球运动、等高线地形图、海陆板块、世界气候判读与人口聚落，每次重新组卷并自动收录错题。

title: Earth's movement: time zones, daylength and solar altitude
地球的运动：时差、昼夜长短与正午太阳高度
blurb: Angular vs linear speed, local solar time and Date Line rules, daylength variations, and noon sun angle H = 90° − |φ − δ|.
自转角速度与线速度、地方时与日界线计算、昼夜长短变化规律以及正午太阳高度角公式与应用。

title: Five basic landforms
五种基本地形
blurb: Plains, plateaus, mountains, hills and basins on land, and shelves, ridges and trenches under the sea: what tells them apart, and where the biggest are.
陆地上的平原、高原、山地、丘陵、盆地，海底的大陆架、海岭、海沟：怎样区分，最大的在哪里。

title: Seven continents, four oceans
七大洲和四大洋
blurb: How much of the Earth is sea, what continents, islands and peninsulas are, where each continent ends, and which straits join the oceans.
地球上海洋占多少，什么是大陆、岛屿和半岛，各大洲的分界在哪里，哪些海峡连通大洋。

title: Plates on the move
板块的运动
blurb: Seas become land and land becomes sea. Six great plates drift slowly; where they collide, split or slide, mountains rise, rifts open and the ground shakes.
沧海桑田，海陆变迁。六大板块缓慢漂移，在碰撞、张裂和错动的地方，山脉隆起、裂谷张开、地震频发。

title: Changing land and sea
海陆的变迁
blurb: How a jigsaw-shaped coastline and some old fossils showed that continents move.
从拼图般的海岸线和古老化石出发，看看大陆是怎样漂移的。

title: Rocks and the rock cycle
岩石与岩石循环
blurb: Three kinds of rock, and how wind, water and ice wear them down and build them up again.
三大类岩石，以及风、流水和冰怎样把它们磨蚀、又重新塑造。

title: Rivers: from source to mouth
河流：从源头到河口
blurb: How rivers carve valleys and waterfalls, then wind across plains and build deltas.
河流怎样切出峡谷和瀑布，又怎样蜿蜒流过平原、堆积出三角洲。

title: Coasts
海岸
blurb: Waves carve cliffs, caves, arches and stacks, and build beaches and spits.
海浪雕琢出海蚀崖、海蚀洞、海蚀拱桥和海蚀柱，也堆积出海滩和沙嘴。

title: Glaciers and ice
冰川
blurb: Ice sheets, valley glaciers and the ice ages that reshaped the world.
冰盖、山岳冰川，以及改变了世界面貌的冰期。

title: The water cycle
水循环
blurb: Where Earth's water is, and how it travels between sea, sky and land.
地球上的水在哪里，它怎样在海洋、天空和陆地之间循环。

title: Natural hazards
自然灾害
blurb: Earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanoes and tropical storms: where they strike and how to be ready.
地震、海啸、火山和台风：它们发生在哪里，我们怎样防范。

title: The history of the Earth
地球的历史
blurb: Read 4.6 billion years in layers of rock: the eons and eras, the rise of life, two great extinctions and the coal ages.
在一层层岩石里读懂 46 亿年：地质年代、生物的演化、两次生物大灭绝和成煤时期。

title: The Earth’s layers
地球的圈层结构
blurb: Use earthquake waves to see inside the Earth: the Moho, the Gutenberg discontinuity, crust, mantle and core, and the spheres outside.
借助地震波“看清”地球内部：莫霍面、古登堡面，地壳、地幔、地核，以及外部圈层。

title: Common landforms
常见地貌类型
blurb: Karst, river, desert, coastal and glacial landforms: how water, wind, waves and ice carve and build the land.
喀斯特、河流、风沙、海岸和冰川地貌：流水、风、海浪和冰川怎样侵蚀和堆积出各种地貌。

title: Vegetation and soil
植被与土壤
blurb: How forests, grasslands and desert plants fit their climates, what soil is made of, how it forms, and why black soil is so rich.
森林、草原和荒漠植被怎样适应环境，土壤由什么组成、怎样形成，黑土为什么那么肥沃。

title: The forces that shape the land
塑造地表形态的力量
blurb: Internal forces raise, fold and break the crust; external forces wear it down. Follow the rock cycle and see why an anticline can become a valley.
内力抬升、弯曲、断裂地壳，外力削高填低。认识岩石圈物质循环，看看背斜为什么会成谷。

unit: Unity and diversity of the natural environment
自然环境的整体性与差异性
title: The natural environment as a whole
自然环境的整体性
blurb: Climate, water, landforms, soil and life are all linked: change one and the rest follow, as the Amazon and the Loess Plateau show.
气候、水文、地形、土壤、生物相互联系：牵一发而动全身。以亚马孙雨林和黄土高原为例。

unit: Unity and diversity of the natural environment
自然环境的整体性与差异性
title: Natural zones: from equator to pole, coast to inland, foot to summit
自然环境的地域差异
blurb: Why natural zones change with latitude, with distance from the sea and with height, build your own mountain of belts, and spot places that break the pattern.
自然带为什么随纬度、距海远近和海拔高度变化？亲手“造”一座有垂直自然带的山，再找找打破规律的地方。

unit: 高中必修第一册 · 综合题库
title: Senior Compulsory 1 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
高中必修第一册 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn senior mock exam on Earth's spheres & history, atmospheric heating & thermal circulation, water cycle & ocean currents, landforms, soils, and vegetation.
涵盖地球的宇宙环境与圈层结构、大气受热过程与热力环流、水循环与洋流、喀斯特/流水/风沙/海岸/冰川地貌、土壤与植被。

title: Temperature and rainfall
气温和降水
blurb: How temperature changes through the day and the year, why it falls with latitude and height, and where in the world it rains most.
气温在一天和一年中怎样变化，为什么随纬度和海拔升高而降低；世界上哪里降水最多。

title: Weather, wind and air
多变的天气
blurb: Tell weather from climate, read forecasts, symbols and satellite images, check the air quality, then meet the wind belts and monsoons.
区分天气和气候，读懂天气预报、天气符号和卫星云图，了解空气质量，再认识气压带、风带和季风。

title: World climates: the tropics
世界的气候类型（一）：热带
blurb: The world climate map, then the four tropical climates: their graphs, where they are and what causes them.
认识世界气候类型分布图，再读懂四种热带气候的气候图、分布和成因。

title: World climates: temperate, cold and highland
世界的气候类型（二）
blurb: Read and compare climate graphs, meet the climates outside the tropics, find out what shapes them and learn to name a climate from its graph.
学会阅读和比较气候图，认识热带以外的气候类型和影响气候的因素，学会根据气候图判断气候类型。

title: Biomes: climate and life
气候与自然植被
blurb: Each climate grows its own kind of vegetation, and its own animals. Tour the world's biomes.
不同的气候孕育不同的自然植被和动物。一起游览世界的自然带。

title: Climate change
全球气候变暖
blurb: How greenhouse gases warm the planet, where they come from, what is changing, and how we can cut them and adapt.
温室气体怎样使地球变暖、从哪里来，带来哪些变化，以及人类怎样减缓和适应。

title: Composition and layers of the atmosphere
大气的组成和垂直分层
blurb: What air is made of, and why it gets colder, then warmer, then colder again as you climb to 120 km.
大气由什么组成？从地面升到 120 千米，气温为什么先降、再升、又降？

title: How the atmosphere is heated
大气的受热过程
blurb: Sunlight warms the ground, the ground warms the air, the air sends warmth back: why clear nights are frosty and Tibet is sunny but cold.
太阳暖大地，大地暖大气，大气还大地：为什么晴朗的夜晚多霜冻，青藏高原阳光强却气温低？

title: Thermal circulation
热力环流
blurb: Warm air rises, cool air sinks, and the wind blows between them: sea breezes, valley breezes and the city's own wind.
受热上升，冷却下沉，水平方向由高压流向低压：海陆风、山谷风和城市风。

title: Horizontal motion of the air: wind
大气的水平运动——风
blurb: Three forces steer the wind: the pressure gradient pushes, the Earth's spin turns it, friction slows it.
三个力决定风向：气压梯度力推动，地转偏向力使它偏转，摩擦力使它减速。

title: Pressure belts and wind belts
气压带和风带
blurb: Three cells of rising and sinking air wrap each hemisphere, laying down seven pressure belts and six wind belts that follow the Sun.
每个半球有三圈环流，形成七个气压带和六个风带，并随太阳直射点季节移动。

title: Pressure and wind belts shape climate
气压带和风带对气候的影响
blurb: Why rainforests sit on the equator, deserts near the tropics and Mediterranean summers are dry, and how monsoons form.
为什么雨林在赤道、沙漠在回归线附近、地中海夏季干燥？季风是怎样形成的？

title: Common weather systems
常见天气系统
blurb: Cold fronts, warm fronts, the plum rains, typhoons and the long dry spells of high summer.
冷锋、暖锋、梅雨、台风和伏旱，都是怎样形成的？

title: Properties and motion of sea water
海水的性质和运动
blurb: Why the Red Sea is the saltiest sea, why a desert lies beside the Pacific, and where the great fishing grounds are.
红海为什么最咸？太平洋边上为什么有沙漠？世界大渔场分布在哪里？

unit: 高中选择性必修 1 · 综合题库
title: Senior Elective 1 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
高中选择性必修 1 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn senior mock exam on Earth's rotation/revolution & solar calculations, rock cycle & geological structures, pressure belts & monsoons, weather systems, and physical zonation.
全面覆盖地球自转与公转计算、岩石圈物质循环与内力构造、气压带风带与季风、锋面气旋天气系统、自然环境整体性与地域分异规律。

title: World population
人口与人种
blurb: Eight billion of us: how fast we grew, where we crowd together and where almost nobody lives.
世界人口已超过 80 亿：增长有多快，人们聚居在哪里，哪里几乎无人居住。

title: Population structure and migration
人口结构与人口迁移
blurb: Read a population pyramid, and find out why people move from place to place.
学会读人口金字塔，了解人们为什么要迁移。

title: Languages and religions
语言和宗教
blurb: The six languages of the United Nations, the world's main religions, and treasures of human culture.
联合国的六种工作语言、世界主要宗教，以及人类的文化遗产。

title: Settlements and urbanisation
聚落
blurb: Villages and cities: where they grow, how fast the world is moving to towns, and the giant megacities.
乡村和城市：聚落在哪里形成，城市化有多快，还有巨大的“超级城市”。

title: Development and cooperation
发展与合作
blurb: Developed and developing countries, how to measure development, and working together for a better world.
发达国家与发展中国家、如何衡量发展水平，以及携手共建更美好的世界。

title: Economic activity and resources
经济活动与资源
blurb: Farms, factories and services; the ships that carry world trade; oil, sunshine and wind; and where your phone comes from.
农业、工业和服务业；运送世界贸易的船只；石油、阳光和风能；还有你的手机从哪里来。

title: Asia
亚洲
blurb: The continent we live on: the biggest and most crowded, high in the middle, ringed by rivers and ruled by the monsoon.
我们生活的大洲：面积最大、人口最多，中部高四周低，河流放射状，季风显著。

title: Japan and Southeast Asia
日本和东南亚
blurb: An island country on shaky ground that lives by trade, and the crossroads between two oceans.
多火山地震、靠加工贸易发展的岛国，和两大洋之间的“十字路口”。

title: Australia
澳大利亚
blurb: A whole continent for one country: ancient animals, a dry red heart, and a nation that rode on the sheep's back and the mine cart.
独占一块大陆的国家：古老的生物、干旱的“红色中心”，“骑在羊背上”和“坐在矿车上”的国家。

title: The polar regions
极地地区
blurb: An ice-buried continent and a frozen ocean: the coldest, windiest places on Earth, now the frontier of science.
冰雪覆盖的大陆和冰封的海洋：地球上最冷、风最大的地方，也是科学考察的前沿。

unit: Countries and regions of the Eastern Hemisphere
东半球其他的国家和地区
title: The Middle East
中东
blurb: Where three continents meet: oil under the sand, water in short supply, and holy cities for three faiths.
“两洋三洲五海之地”：丰富的石油、匮乏的水资源和多元的文化。

unit: Countries and regions of the Eastern Hemisphere
东半球其他的国家和地区
title: Western Europe and the EU
欧洲西部
blurb: Mild, wet winds from the Atlantic, green pastures, famous sights and countries that work together.
大西洋吹来的温和湿润的风、绿色的牧场、闻名世界的旅游胜地和紧密合作的国家。

unit: Countries and regions of the Eastern Hemisphere
东半球其他的国家和地区
title: Sub-Saharan Africa
撒哈拉以南非洲
blurb: A high plateau continent, great rivers, savanna wildlife, and fast-growing young nations.
黑种人的故乡：高原大陆、大江大河、草原上的野生动物，以及人口快速增长的国家。

unit: Countries and regions of the Eastern Hemisphere
东半球其他的国家和地区
title: Russia
俄罗斯
blurb: The biggest country on Earth: across Europe and Asia, rivers to the Arctic, cold winters and a railway 9,000 km long.
世界上面积最大的国家：地跨两洲，河流北流，冬季严寒，资源丰富，铁路绵延 9000 多千米。

unit: Countries and regions of the Eastern Hemisphere
东半球其他的国家和地区
title: India
印度
blurb: A subcontinent shaped by the Himalayas and the monsoon: rice and wheat, booming software and the world's largest population.
喜马拉雅山和季风塑造的次大陆：稻麦之乡、软件大国和世界第一的人口。

title: The United States
美国
blurb: A nation of immigrants on a land of mountains and plains, with farm belts, old industrial cities and high-tech valleys.
移民国家：西部山地、中部平原、东部山地，农业地区专业化，高新技术产业发达。

title: Brazil
巴西
blurb: The giant of South America: the Amazon rainforest and the fight to save it, coffee and soybeans, and a mixed, lively culture.
南美洲的大国：亚马孙雨林的开发与保护，咖啡和大豆，以及多元的混血文化。

unit: 我们邻近的地区和国家
title: Southeast Asia: Crossroads & Tropical Farming
东南亚：“十字路口”与热带农业
blurb: The Strait of Malacca, parallel mountains and rivers on the Indo-China Peninsula, and monsoon rice and cash crops.
马六甲海峡、中南半岛“山河相间、纵列分布”的地形，以及水稻和热带经济作物。

unit: 七年级下册 · 综合题库
title: Grade 7 Term 2 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
七年级下册 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn mock exam covering Asia, Japan, SE Asia, India, Russia, Middle East, Europe, Africa, Australia, USA, Brazil, and Polar regions.
全面覆盖亚洲、日本、东南亚、印度、俄罗斯、中东、欧洲西部、撒哈拉以南非洲、澳大利亚、美国、巴西与极地地区。

title: Landforms and the three steps
地形多样，地势西高东低
blurb: Mountains, plateaus, basins and plains, falling in three big steps from the roof of the world to the sea.
山地、高原、盆地、平原和丘陵，从世界屋脊到大海分三级阶梯逐级下降。

title: China's climate and rivers
中国的气候和河流
blurb: Winter and summer temperatures, rain belts and monsoons, the Qinling–Huaihe line, and the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers.
冬夏气温、雨带和季风、秦岭—淮河一线，以及长江和黄河。

title: China's territory and divisions
疆域与行政区划
blurb: Where China is, how big it is, its neighbours, seas and islands, and its 34 provincial-level divisions.
我国的位置、面积、邻国、海域与岛屿，以及 34 个省级行政区。

title: Population and ethnic groups
人口与民族
blurb: 1.41 billion people, an ageing population, a crowded east and a sparse west, and 56 ethnic groups.
14.1 亿人口、老龄化、东密西疏的人口分布，以及 56 个民族组成的大家庭。

title: Land and water resources
土地资源与水资源
blurb: Rich in total but poor per person; farmland to guard; water uneven in place and time, moved south to north.
总量丰富、人均不足；守住耕地红线；水资源时空分布不均与南水北调。

title: Farming, industry, transport and culture
农业、工业、交通与地域文化
blurb: Rice in the south, wheat in the north, factories on the coast, fast trains and giant ports, and houses that fit the land.
南稻北麦、东耕西牧，沿海工业密集，高铁与大港连通内外，民居与环境相适应。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The northern region
北方地区
blurb: Black soil, the wheat lands of the North China Plain, spring drought, coal on the Loess Plateau and the ancient capitals.
黑土地、华北平原的麦田与春旱、黄土高原的煤炭，以及黄河流域的古都。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The southern region
南方地区
blurb: Rivers, lakes and paddy fields, plum rains and typhoons, the Sichuan Basin, karst hills, two great deltas and two big islands.
河湖与水田、梅雨与台风、四川盆地、喀斯特山地、两大三角洲和两大岛屿。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The northwest and the Qinghai–Tibet region
西北地区和青藏地区
blurb: Grassland, oases and deserts in the dry northwest; energy and green walls; the high, cold roof of the world.
干旱的西北：草原、绿洲与荒漠，能源与防沙治沙；高寒的青藏：世界屋脊与江河之源。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The four geographical regions
中国的四大地理区域
blurb: Three dividing lines split China into the north, the south, the northwest and Qinghai–Tibet.
三条分界线把我国分为北方、南方、西北和青藏四大地理区域。

title: The Yangtze River
长江
blurb: From a Tibetan glacier to Shanghai: power, shipping, floods and protection on China's longest river.
从青藏高原的冰川到上海：中国第一长河的水能、航运、防洪与保护。

title: The Yellow River
黄河
blurb: The mother river: irrigation, silt from the Loess Plateau, a riverbed above the plain, and how it is tamed.
母亲河：灌溉之利、黄土高原的泥沙、高出地面的“地上河”，以及黄河的治理。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The Northeast: black soil and white snow
东北三省：白山黑水
blurb: Mountains around wide plains, fertile black soil, long cold winters: a granary, an old industrial base and an ice-and-snow playground.
山环水绕、沃野千里、冬季漫长：东北是商品粮基地、老工业基地和冰雪旅游胜地。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The Loess Plateau
黄土高原
blurb: Dust blown from the northwest built the world's largest loess plateau; rain has cut it into a thousand gullies.
西北吹来的尘土堆成世界最大的黄土高原，雨水又把它切割得千沟万壑。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: Qinghai–Tibet: roof of the world, source of rivers
青藏地区：世界屋脊与江河源
blurb: High and cold but sunny: the sources of great rivers, yak pastures, barley valleys and a railway on frozen ground.
高寒而日照强烈：大江大河的源头、牦牛牧场、青稞河谷和冻土上的铁路。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: Beijing, the capital
祖国的首都——北京
blurb: Four centres, an ancient capital on its central axis, and a capital region that shares the load.
四个中心、古都与中轴线、疏解非首都功能与京津冀协同发展。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: The Yangtze River Delta
长江三角洲地区
blurb: Water towns and the Grand Canal, Shanghai the dragon head, and China's biggest city cluster.
江南水乡与大运河，“龙头”上海，我国最大的城市群。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: Hong Kong and Macao
香港和澳门
blurb: Two special administrative regions at the Pearl River mouth, the bridge that joins them, and the Greater Bay Area.
珠江口的两个特别行政区、港珠澳大桥与粤港澳大湾区。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: Taiwan Province
祖国的神圣领土——台湾省
blurb: Mountains in the east and plains in the west, typhoons and rain, a treasure island of farms and factories.
东部多山、西部平原，台风与多雨，物产丰富的宝岛与加工出口工业。

unit: 中国的地理差异与区域
title: Xinjiang: mountains, deserts and oases
新疆：山地、沙漠与绿洲
blurb: Three ranges and two basins, the Tarim River, oasis farms and karez, Turpan, gas pipelines and the Silk Road.
三山夹两盆、塔里木河、绿洲农业与坎儿井、吐鲁番盆地、西气东输与丝绸之路。

title: China in the world
中国在世界中
blurb: A top economy and trader, the Belt and Road, China–Europe trains, our seas and islands, and the climate pledge.
经济大国与贸易大国、“一带一路”、中欧班列、海洋权益与南海诸岛，以及“双碳”目标。

title: China's natural hazards and prevention
中国的自然灾害与防灾减灾
blurb: Monsoon droughts and floods, typhoons, cold waves, and why earthquakes and debris flows cluster in the southwest.
旱涝、台风、寒潮等气象灾害，以及地震、滑坡、泥石流等地质灾害的分布与防灾减灾。

unit: 中国的地域差异与区域发展
title: The Pearl River Delta and Greater Bay Area
珠江三角洲与粤港澳大湾区
blurb: China's southern gateway: overseas Chinese ties, industrial upgrading, and cross-estuary mega-bridges.
祖国的“南大门”：毗邻港澳的区位优势、产业转型升级与跨江通道群。

unit: 八年级上册 · 综合题库
title: Grade 8 Term 1 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
八年级上册 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn mock exam on China's territory & provinces, population, Three Terrain Steps, climate & Qinling–Huaihe line, Yangtze & Yellow River, resources, and railways.
涵盖中国的疆域与行政区划、人口民族、三级阶梯与地形区、气候与秦岭—淮河线、长江黄河、自然资源与防灾减灾及交通运输。

unit: 八年级下册 · 综合题库
title: Grade 8 Term 2 · Question Bank & Mock Exam
八年级下册 · 综合题库与期末模拟
blurb: Freshly drawn mock exam on China's Four Major Geographical Regions, Northeast, Loess Plateau, Beijing, YRD, PRD/HK/Macau, Taiwan, Xinjiang, and Sanjiangyuan.
全面覆盖四大地理区域划分、北方（东北三省、黄土高原、北京）、南方（长三角、港澳、珠三角、台湾）、西北（塔里木盆地）与青藏（三江源）。

title: The Sun and the Moon
太阳和月球
blurb: How big and how far: a star 109 times wider than the Earth, and a dusty, airless Moon.
有多大、有多远：直径是地球 109 倍的恒星，和没有空气、布满尘土的月球。

title: Phases of the Moon and the lunar calendar
月相和农历
blurb: Why the Moon changes shape through a month, and how the Chinese lunar calendar follows it.
月亮为什么一个月里会“变脸”，农历又是怎样跟着月相走的。

title: Solar and lunar eclipses
日食和月食
blurb: When the Sun, the Earth and the Moon line up: shadows in space, and why it does not happen every month.
当日、地、月排成一条直线：太空中的影子，以及为什么不是每个月都有日食和月食。

title: Tides
潮汐
blurb: Why the sea rises and falls twice a day, and why some tides are much bigger than others.
海水为什么一天涨落两次，为什么有时潮水特别大。

title: The eight planets
八大行星
blurb: Meet the Sun’s family: rocky inner worlds, giant outer worlds, and the dwarf planets beyond.
认识太阳的家族：岩质的类地行星、庞大的巨行星，还有更远处的矮行星。

title: How big is the Solar System?
太阳系有多大
blurb: Astronomical units, a Sun the size of a football, and light that takes hours to cross the planets.
天文单位、足球大小的太阳，以及要走几个小时才能穿过行星的光。

title: Asteroids, comets and meteors
小行星、彗星和流星
blurb: Rocky asteroids, icy comets with tails that point away from the Sun, and the dust that makes shooting stars.
岩质的小行星、尾巴背向太阳的冰质彗星，以及化作流星的尘埃。

title: Celestial systems and life on Earth
天体系统和地球上的生命
blurb: From the Earth–Moon system to the observable universe, and why Earth is a planet with life.
从地月系到可观测宇宙，以及地球为什么是一颗有生命的行星。

title: How the Solar System formed
太阳系的形成
blurb: From a cold, slowly turning cloud to a Sun and eight planets: the nebular hypothesis, step by step.
从一团缓慢旋转的冷云到太阳和八大行星：一步步看懂星云假说。

title: Constellations and the seasonal sky
星座和四季星空
blurb: Why the stars wheel round the pole every night, and why each season has its own constellations.
星星为什么每晚绕着北天极转，每个季节为什么能看到不同的星座。

title: Finding north by Polaris
北极星辨方向
blurb: Use the Big Dipper to find Polaris, and Polaris to find north and your latitude.
用北斗七星找到北极星，再用北极星辨认方向、估计纬度。

title: Astronomy in ancient China
中国古代天文
blurb: Three enclosures, 28 lunar mansions and four sacred animals: how China mapped the sky, and what its records still tell astronomers.
三垣、二十八宿和四象：古人怎样划分星空，他们的观测记录今天仍在帮助天文学家。

title: Stargazing for beginners
观星入门
blurb: Magnitudes, dark skies and dark-adapted eyes: how to see more stars, find Polaris and catch a meteor shower.
星等、暗夜和暗适应：怎样看到更多的星，找到北极星，迎接流星雨。

unit: Planets and models of the universe
title: Retrograde motion: Earth-centred and Sun-centred models
行星逆行，地心说和日心说
blurb: Why Mars sometimes loops backwards, how Ptolemy and Copernicus explained it, and what Galileo saw.
火星为什么有时会倒退打圈，托勒密和哥白尼怎样解释，伽利略又看到了什么。

title: The 24 solar terms
二十四节气
blurb: China’s farming calendar cuts the Earth’s orbit into 24 equal steps, and the tilted axis turns them into seasons.
把地球公转轨道等分成 24 段的农事历法，以及让节气变成季节的倾斜地轴。

title: The gnomon and the Sun’s shadow
圭表与日影
blurb: A stick in the ground tells the time, the seasons and the length of the year, and Guo Shoujing built a 12-metre one.
一根立在地上的杆子，就能测出时间、季节和一年的长度，郭守敬还把它建到了 12 米高。

unit: 太阳对地球的影响与地球运动
title: Solar radiation and solar activity
太阳辐射和太阳活动
blurb: Where the Earth's energy comes from, and how storms on the Sun reach us.
地球的能量从哪里来，太阳上的“风暴”又怎样影响地球。

unit: 太阳对地球的影响与地球运动
title: Local time, time zones and the date line
地方时、时区和日界线
blurb: Work out the time anywhere, and find where on Earth the new day has begun.
算出任何地方的时间，找出地球上哪些地方已进入新的一天。

unit: 太阳对地球的影响与地球运动
title: The noon Sun's altitude
正午太阳高度
blurb: How high the Sun climbs at noon, from place to place and season to season, and why it matters for houses.
正午太阳有多高？它怎样随纬度和季节变化，又怎样决定楼间距。

unit: 太阳对地球的影响与地球运动
title: Day and night: how long?
昼夜长短的变化
blurb: Why summer days are long, and why the Arctic has days that never end.
为什么夏季白昼长，北极地区又为什么会有“不落的太阳”。

title: Humans explore space
人类探索太空
blurb: Rockets, satellites, the Tiangong space station, Chang’e to the Moon and Tianwen-1 to Mars.
火箭和卫星、天宫空间站、嫦娥探月和天问一号探火。

title: Gravity keeps the planets going round
引力让行星绕太阳转
blurb: Why the planets circle the Sun, what would happen without gravity, why you would weigh less on the Moon, and how gravity raises tides and builds worlds.
行星为什么绕太阳转？没有引力会怎样？为什么在月球上体重会变轻？引力怎样掀起潮汐、塑造星球？

title: Kepler’s three laws
开普勒三定律
blurb: From epicycles to ellipses: equal areas in equal times, T² ∝ a³, the longer summer half-year, Halley’s Comet, and why gravity makes it all work.
从本轮到椭圆：面积定律、T² ∝ a³、更长的夏半年、哈雷彗星，以及万有引力为什么能解释这一切。

title: Gravitation and the cosmic speeds
万有引力和宇宙速度
blurb: The Moon test, F = GMm/r², weighing the Earth and the Sun, the three cosmic speeds 7.9, 11.2 and 16.7 km/s, and why China launches from Wenchang.
月地检验、F = GMm/r²、“称量”地球和太阳、三个宇宙速度 7.9、11.2、16.7 千米/秒，以及为什么在文昌发射。

title: Orbits of artificial satellites
人造卫星的轨道
blurb: Why higher satellites are slower, Tiangong and weightlessness, polar and geostationary orbits, BeiDou, changing orbits, and which orbit suits which job.
为什么卫星越高越慢？天宫与失重、极地轨道和地球静止轨道、北斗系统、变轨，以及不同任务选什么轨道。

title: Stars: brightness, colour and temperature
恒星：亮度、颜色和温度
blurb: What a star’s colour, brightness and tiny yearly shift tell us — and the HR diagram that ties them together.
恒星的颜色、亮度和每年微小的位移告诉了我们什么，以及把它们联系起来的赫罗图。

title: The life of a star
恒星的一生
blurb: Fusion, two paths decided by mass, supernovae that make the elements, and the Sun’s future.
核聚变、由质量决定的两条演化道路、制造元素的超新星，以及太阳的未来。

title: Black holes and neutron stars
黑洞和中子星
blurb: What a giant star leaves behind: city-sized neutron stars, pulsars and black holes that even light cannot escape.
大质量恒星死亡后留下什么：城市大小的中子星、脉冲星，以及连光都逃不出去的黑洞。

title: Finding exoplanets
寻找系外行星
blurb: Planets of other stars are too faint to see: we find them by the wobble and the shadow they give their stars.
其他恒星的行星太暗，几乎看不见：我们通过恒星的“晃动”和行星挡住的星光找到它们。

title: Telescopes and the electromagnetic spectrum
望远镜与电磁波谱
blurb: Lenses and mirrors, why aperture matters, and why some telescopes must fly above the air, from FAST to JWST.
透镜和反射镜、口径为什么重要、为什么有的望远镜必须飞到大气层外——从中国天眼到韦布。

title: The Milky Way and the universe
银河系和宇宙
blurb: Our galaxy, where the Sun sits in it, the light-year, and a universe full of galaxies.
我们的星系、太阳在银河系中的位置、光年，以及充满星系的宇宙。

title: Red-shift and the Big Bang
红移和大爆炸
blurb: Galaxies are rushing apart, the farther the faster: run the film backwards and everything began 13.8 billion years ago.
星系彼此远离，越远退行越快：把“电影”倒放，宇宙起源于 138 亿年前。
